title: Upgrade-safe endpoint reconciler and ephemeral SG preflight checks
author: Sylvia Cho
description:
Context: Private control plane upgrades previously applied endpoint and security-group changes in-place, which caused transient connectivity issues during canary rollouts. This PR introduces an upgrade-safe endpoint reconciler that performs staged changes and a preflight runner that provisions ephemeral security groups and validates connectivity/policy before any destructive changes are applied.
Motivation: reduce blast radius during Private installer upgrades; give operators a fast, deterministic preflight that mirrors production routing and DNS behavior.
Summary of changes: 1) Terraform: add 'ephemeral_sg' optional resource set and a deterministic 'subnet_affinity' module flag that, when enabled, allocates az-subnet claims the same way during plan and apply to avoid drift. 2) Installer controller: add EndpointReconciler v2 (idempotent, adopts existing endpoints, supports staged replace + fallback) and an EphemeralPreflightRunner that creates ephemeral SGs and test endpoints in a temp namespace. 3) Helm chart: expose new values (preflight.enabled, preflight.timeout, reconciler.stage_window_ms) and add RBAC rules for the preflight runner. 4) DNS: introduce a 'preflight-ttl' path for Route53/Consul tests and a conditional 'dns-stitcher' fallback used only during staging to avoid full-record flips. 5) Tests & tooling: e2e test harness that runs the preflight flow in CI (k8s-integration job), plus a small CLI helper (installer ctl preflight run) to trigger the same flow locally.
Design notes: - Reconciler is optimistic: it attempts server-side minimal PATCH, then if it detects incompatible changes (CIDR or service owner diff) it creates replacement endpoints and keeps the old ones until traffic drain completes. - Preflight runner uses ephemeral security groups that are tagged with installer:preflight=<run-id>; those SGs are short-lived and automatically garbage-collected on success/failure. - Rollback plan: if preflight fails, the reconciler aborts the staged rollout and annotates the control-plane resource with the failure reason; operator can run 'installer ctl preflight report <run-id>' to inspect logs and decisions. - Safety: all ephemeral resources are created in a customer-owned, nonce-scoped namespace and require a new IAM permission (ec2:CreateTags + ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup) documented in README.
Checklist: - [x] Terraform resources and variables added and documented - [x] Helm values and RBAC updates - [x] EndpointReconciler implementation and unit tests - [x] EphemeralPreflightRunner + e2e tests - [x] CLI hook for local preflight runs - [x] Docs and upgrade notes - [x] Linear ticket(s) updated
Testing done: - Unit tests for reconciler state machine and preflight runner (local) - Integration tests in CI (k8s-integration) exercising preflight against a mini-cluster (mocked Route53/Consul) - Manual canary run against an internal staging VPC (screenshot logs attached in PR comment)
Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature flag 'reconciler_v2_enabled' on the installer; default false for 1 week, flip for internal accounts, monitor SLOs and route53 delta metrics. Related: builds on work in ENG-6882 (subnet affinity) and addresses incidents flagged by SUP-2241.
Release notes: "Introduce an upgrade-safe EndpointReconciler and a preflight runner that uses ephemeral security groups to validate endpoint and DNS changes before they are applied to production. Operators should enable reconciler_v2_enabled behind a staged rollout."
CI notes: k8s-integration job uses an experimental cluster with mocked DNS; full-cloud integration was run manually and validated in staging.

review_thread: Arjun Patel: Overall this looks good. A few safety questions: how do we ensure the ephemeral SGs cannot be used as a backdoor? Please show tag scoping and a TTL GC mechanism.
Sylvia Cho: Added tag scoping (installer:preflight=<run-id>, customer-id) and a GC controller that deletes SGs older than preflight.gc_ttl (default 2h). Tests added in runner_integration_test.go.
Marta Ruiz: Tests are solid, but I want a clearer error path for 'partial failure' (some AZs succeed, others fail). Can we make reconciler annotate per-az and surface that in the CLI?
Sylvia Cho: Reconciler now writes annotations reconciler.preflight.az.<az>=<ok|fail> and CLI report shows per-az statuses. Updated tests and docs.
Liam O'Connor: Security review: IAM change acceptable but needs a note in upgrade docs for enterprises without ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup — added fallback instructions to use maintain_existing_sg flag.
Arjun Patel: Approving after small nits fixed (typo in docs).
release_notes: Introduce an upgrade-safe EndpointReconciler (v2) that stages endpoint replacements to avoid downtime during Private installer upgrades. Adds an Ephemeral Preflight Runner that provisions ephemeral security groups and validates endpoint + DNS changes before production application. Feature is behind reconciler_v2_enabled and requires additional IAM tags/permissions. See docs/private-installer/upgrade-safety.md for migration and rollback steps.
notes: Manual full-cloud validation was executed against staging account redwood-staging-priv-3. No regressions observed in latency or DNS flaps over a 2-hour canary. Follow-up tasks: ENG-7231 (monitoring alerts for reconciler_v2), ENG-7240 (add CSP-style audit entries for preflight runs).
